{{Quote|We barely made it out of that system alive. We never would have made it without Colonel Northal.|Airen Cracken|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Vin Northal''' was a member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Vin Northal was born around the time [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was elected as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], to parents who were already passionate supporters of the future Emperor's ambitions for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a teenager in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] early years, he grew up believing that the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] existed to create peace and prosperity throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and excelled in the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]]-sponsored [[SAGEducation/Legends|SAGEducation]] program where he was a [[wegsphere]] champion at the age of fourteen. His achievements earned the attention of a recruiter for [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]], and he was offered a chance to join the unit. Northal turned them down and applied to the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. He was accepted and graduated at the top of his class, setting a new goal for cadets in the process.<ref name="CRO" />

===Military career===
Northal graduated as an officer in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and his abilities earned him the right to special forces training. He was assigned to the command of one of the Empire's best squad commanders, [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. After two years, Northal gained his own command, and shortly after that was selected for [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commander]] training while also doubling as an infiltration instructor. He graduated with command of his own squad. A year later, Northal was invited to join the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] where his skills were honed and sharpened. As a Guardsman, Northal protected the Emperor, suppressed protests, and fought the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] on the front lines. During his customary rotation with a stormtrooper unit, he participated in the [[Pacification of Meastrinnar|pacification]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meastrinnar]]. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] relayed intelligence that a Rebel cell had been located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vondrel]]. Northal led his squad to the target building where they proceeded to terminate all occupants with no resistance. Only after did he find out that the building they raided was an orphanage. The ISB transmission had been incorrectly decoded. The Rebels were in the sister city on [[Vondrol]]. Northal's unit had massacred dozens of sleeping children.<ref name="CRO" />

Despite the mistake, Northal's superiors considered the mission a victory and media networks made no mention of the true outcome of the mission. Struggling to reconcile his ideals with the reality of the Imperial regime, Northal used his security access to review battle records and captured Alliance documentation to see if other stories of Imperial atrocities were true. After investigating, he decided to defect to the Rebel Alliance. Allowing himself to be captured on his next mission, he requested political asylum. His former commander, Crix Madine, was now a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] and vouched for Northal. While Madine's faith in Northal was enough for [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] remained distrustful of Northal until he [[Ambush on Hythrope IV|saved]] the entirety of the Alliance [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]] on [[Hythrope IV]] by singlehandedly taking out a [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] and thirty stormtroopers.<ref name="CRO" />

Attaining the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], Vin Northal served the Alliance as an infiltration and retrieval specialist using his knowledge of Imperial procedure and his own training to complete missions often thought impossible. Insisting on front line service, Northal commanded several [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] missions and trained [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]] in his spare time.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality==
Northal was a deeply conflicted individual whose whole world was shattered after the raid on Meastrinnar. Before that raid he was completely loyal and dedicated to both the New Order and the Empire, believing in the propaganda that they were bringing peace to the galaxy. He realized in horror that the cover up on Meastrinnar meant that the rumors of Imperial atrocities were true and research confirmed his suspicions. In the end he realized that if he wanted to help bring about a peaceful and prosperous society he would have to switch sides and join the Alliance. He was a committed fighter and insisted to be put on the front lines in the fight against the Empire.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a former Royal Guard, Northal was an incredibly skilled combatant who was well trained in combat techniques, tactics and commando operations. He was also highly trained in demolitions which proved very useful on his commando raids.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Northal carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], nine [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], two [[Knife/Legends|throwing knives]] and a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]]. He had a [[survival pack]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], two [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech]] [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpacs]], a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]], a [[Droid caller/Legends|restraining bolt deactivator]], lockpicks and a [[lectroticker]]. He also wore camouflaged clothing.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vin Northal was designed by [[David R. Tulo, Jr.|David R. Tulo]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Doug Shuler]].
